verdict.rationale: Atlassian publishes the Jira Cloud platform REST API as a versioned, documented reference backed by a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec with 433 paths. A formal REST API policy commits to at least six months of availability for deprecated endpoints, and community users report scripting Jira through its REST API and JQL queries. The generic-path OpenAPI probe 404s don't contradict this, because the spec is published at its documented URL. Missing for 10: no evidence in the pack covering API authentication or rate-limit documentation, and no in-page interactive console (only a Postman collection).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
